changes_vs_current: New topic. Scope: generic kinds count as one item (owl, parrot, duck, hawk); species fold into their kind (mallard -> Duck, peregrine -> Falcon, golden eagle -> Bald Eagle as 'eagle'; parakeet/macaw/cockatoo -> Parrot). Domestic birds (chicken, turkey) and exotic birds are eligible; extinct dodo eligible but only Wikipedia backs it. Method: averaged positions over 4 people lists (Google Trends types, Google Trends species, Wikipedia pageviews, YouGov UK ratings), missing = list length + 5 only where the kind is inside that source's universe (North American wild birds for the Google data; UK ratings for kinds on its list). Raw average order (items with 2+ sources): Penguin, Bald Eagle, Owl, Chicken, Duck, Peacock, Cardinal, Osprey, Falcon, Blue Jay, Hawk, Goose, Hummingbird, Sparrow, Puffin, Parrot, Dove, Woodpecker, Finch, Heron, Albatross, Robin, Pigeon, Flamingo, Parakeet, Starling, Crane, Swallow, Ostrich, Turkey, Swan, Vulture, Magpie, Crow. Single-source Wikipedia exotics (Dodo, Shoebill, Cassowary, Kiwi, Emu) excluded from the board (no second source; gut check rejects them). Gut-check moves: Bald Eagle to #1 (top of both Google lists and the US GfK survey; raw #2 only because penguin has no Google coverage). Cardinal up to #2 (Google species #2, top bird in 16 states, 7 state birds). Robin raw #22 -> #5 (Google species #4; GfK US survey 2nd-most-liked bird after eagle; its Google type is buried under 'Thrush' and the UK poll has no American robin). Hummingbird raw #13 -> #7 (Google type #12, UK 5/10, Wikipedia #11; Google species list splits it across species). Flamingo raw #24 -> #10 (Wikipedia #25, UK 3/10; not covered by the North American Google data, which is why it trailed). Parrot raw #16 -> #11. Pigeon raw #23 -> #12 (Google type #6; low UK liking reflects dislike, not unfamiliarity). Crow raw #34 -> #15 only (Google type ranks it 29 and UK ratings 24.5, so it stays below #12; the species list misses it because people search 'crow'). Non-gut items pushed down by those moves: Chicken (#14), Peacock (#13), Osprey (#17, Wikipedia-inflated), Falcon (#16, peregrine 'fastest animal' traffic). Turkey brought in at #19 over Puffin (Puffin's rank rests on a UK poll; Turkey is the most-searched US bird name per PNAS 2019).
confidence: Top 6 (Bald Eagle, Cardinal, Owl, Penguin, Robin, Blue Jay): medium-high, but no US favorite-bird poll exists (searched YouGov, Harris, Talker, OnePoll; none found), so the order rests on search and pageview data plus a UK liking poll. 7-12: medium (Hummingbird, Duck, Hawk, Flamingo, Parrot, Pigeon all plausible; exotic kinds rely on only Wikipedia + UK YouGov). 13-24: low-medium; order sensitive to method. Near misses: Ostrich, Swan, Puffin, Seagull, Pelican, Vulture, Raven, Parakeet (folded into Parrot), Toucan, Crane, Mockingbird, Bluebird, Roadrunner. Blocked/unread: allaboutbirds.org (403), birdcount.org GBBC results (403), JetPunk stats (403); Ranker not used. Google Trends data is via the Searching for Birds project's CSVs, not queried directly.
